title:
The Fairy Book
The Best Popular Stories Selected and Rendered Anew
sourceTitle:
The Fairy Book

author: Dinah Maria Mulock Craik
description: "The Fairy Book" by Dinah Maria Mulock Craik is a collection of classic fairy tales compiled and retold for a modern audience, likely written in the mid-19th century.
longDescription: The stories draw from various well-known sources, including works by Perrault and the Brothers Grimm, and exhibit a commitment to preserving the charm of traditional tales while making them accessible to contemporary readers.

authorInfo.bio: Dinah Maria Craik was an English novelist and poet. She wrote the novel, John Halifax, Gentleman, which presents the mid-Victorian ideals of English middle-class life.
